# Errors

Every operation can return `401`, `429` and `500`; most can also return
`400`. The operation pages name the status and link here for the detail.

## Forbidden

The request was valid but the key's context does not allow it. Observed on GET /people/{vanId} with `$expand=scores`: scores are a My Voters feature, so a My Campaign key is refused even though `scores` is in the API's own list of valid sections. The sibling refusal for `pollingLocation` uses 400 BAD_REQUEST instead — the two are not consistent.

Body: [ErrorResponse](ERRORS.md#errorresponse)

## ActionRestricted

The API key's profile does not permit this action at all. The body carries nothing beyond the code, and the check runs before the target is looked up, so a restricted action answers 403 even for an id that does not exist — which also means a 403 here says nothing about whether the target exists.

Distinct from the other 403 in this spec: that one refuses a particular *section* of an otherwise-allowed request (`$expand=scores` from a My Campaign key), while this one refuses the whole operation.

Body: [ErrorResponse](ERRORS.md#errorresponse)

## QueryStringTooLong

The request never reached the API. IIS rejects any request whose query string runs past roughly 2048 characters and answers with its own HTML "404 - File or directory not found" page, so this 404 means the URL was too long rather than that anything was missing. Nothing in the body identifies the real cause; check the content type, since the API's own 404s are JSON.

Body: _empty body_

## NoteCategoryNotFound

No note category with that id exists in the current context, as the standard error envelope. A non-integer path segment, or an id above 2147483647, matches no route at all and gets an IIS HTML page instead; an id of zero or below does reach the handler and answers 500 rather than 404.

Body: [ErrorResponse](ERRORS.md#errorresponse)

## PersonNotFound

No person with that vanId exists. Zero and negative ids return this too, as the standard error envelope. Two non-API cases share this status and answer with an IIS HTML page instead: a non-integer path segment, which matches no route, and a query string longer than ~2048 characters, which IIS rejects outright.

Body: [ErrorResponse](ERRORS.md#errorresponse)

## RequestValidationRedirect

The request never reached the API. ASP.NET request validation rejects a path segment containing `<`, `>`, `*` or `&` and hands the request to the VAN web application, which answers **302** with `Location: /Error.aspx?EID={code}` and a small HTML "Object moved" body. Clients that follow the redirect land on the web app's HTML "Oops...something went wrong" page with status 200 — HTML, not JSON, from an endpoint that otherwise only speaks JSON.

Other unusual path characters take different routes: `:` and `"` give the IIS HTML 404, and a backslash gives the standard JSON 404 envelope.

Body: _empty body_

## BadRequest

Validation error, as the standard JSON envelope.

Two unrelated cases share this status and answer with `text/html` instead, because the request is rejected in front of the API and never reaches it: a percent-encoded control character such as `%7F` in the path gets IIS's "Bad Request - Invalid URL" page, and `%00` gets Cloudflare's "400 Bad Request" page. Check the content type before parsing.

Body: [ErrorResponse](ERRORS.md#errorresponse)

## Unauthorized

Missing/invalid API key, or a database mode the key does not have access to.

Body: [ErrorResponse](ERRORS.md#errorresponse)

## TooManyRequests

Rate limit exceeded. Limits are per API key, set by the key's rate-limit profile, and apply across all endpoints, so any operation can return 429. There is no `Retry-After` header; the suggested wait appears only in the error text ("Try again in N ms."). Unlike other errors, `code` is the numeric string "429" rather than a symbolic name.

Body: [ErrorResponse](ERRORS.md#errorresponse)

## ServerError

Internal server error. The API returns 500 (not 400) for various malformed inputs, e.g. negative delayInMilliseconds on /echoes, non-ASCII filter values on /surveyQuestions, vanId 0 or null phone entries on /people/find, a null phone entry on the person write endpoints, an `identifiers` entry with the valid type `dwid` on POST /people/create, and a negative vanId — in the path or the body — or a secondary equal to the primary on PUT /people/{vanId}/mergeInto. Two body shapes occur: the standard errors envelope (with a referenceCode for support), or a raw ASP.NET exception payload including a stack trace when the request fails before reaching the API's own error handling (e.g. a query-string key containing '[').

Body: [ErrorResponse](ERRORS.md#errorresponse) or [AspNetError](ERRORS.md#aspneterror)

## Error body shapes

### ErrorResponse

The standard error envelope, returned by every failing endpoint except where noted.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `errors` * | array of [Error](ERRORS.md#error) |  |
| `errors.code` * | string | Machine-readable error code. Known values: UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_PARAMETER, BAD_REQUEST, NOT_FOUND, METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (list likely incomplete). e.g. `INVALID_PARAMETER` |
| `errors.text` * | string | Human-readable description of the problem. |
| `errors.properties` | array of string or null | JSON paths of the offending request properties, e.g. "responses[0].shortName". |
| `errors.hint` | string or null | How to fix it — often the accepted values or a regular expression. |
| `errors.referenceCode` | string or null | Support reference code; present on INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR responses. |

`*` = required.

### AspNetError

Raw ASP.NET Web API exception payload, returned on some 500s instead of the standard errors envelope when the request fails before reaching the API's own error handling — e.g. a query-string key containing '[' crashes jQuery-syntax key parsing. Includes a full stack trace.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` * | string | e.g. "An error has occurred." |
| `exceptionMessage` | string or null |  |
| `exceptionType` | string or null | e.g. "System.ArgumentException" |
| `stackTrace` | string or null |  |

`*` = required.

### Error

One problem with the request.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` * | string | Machine-readable error code. Known values: UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_PARAMETER, BAD_REQUEST, NOT_FOUND, METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (list likely incomplete). e.g. `INVALID_PARAMETER` |
| `text` * | string | Human-readable description of the problem. |
| `properties` | array of string or null | JSON paths of the offending request properties, e.g. "responses[0].shortName". |
| `hint` | string or null | How to fix it — often the accepted values or a regular expression. |
| `referenceCode` | string or null | Support reference code; present on INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR responses. |

`*` = required.
